item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 0-2 Millwall
item.description: An own-goal and Josh Coburn’s late strike handed Wrexham defeat at the SToK Cae Ras, as the Red Dragons were beaten 2-0 in North Wales. item.description: Wrexham AFC Women are delighted to announce the signing of Canadian defender Sarah Harvey on a deal until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. item.title: GALLERY | Wrexham AFC 0-2 Millwall
item.description: Wrexham AFC suffered defeat at home to Millwall, as the Red Dragons missed the chance to go level on points with the fifth-placed Lions. The hosts could not make a controlled first half count, as the sides went in goalless at the interval. item.title: INTERNATIONAL CALL-UPS | Wrexham AFC Academy duo named in Cymru youth squads
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce that Cynan Holdsworth and Leo Saxon have been selected for Cymru Under-16s and Under-15s respectively. Holdsworth will travel with the Cymru Under-16s to Cyprus to compete in the UEFA Development Tournament and will play against Romania, Scotland, and hosts Cyprus.
